title: Coral and the Vow
author: Freya Dravenmoor
blurb: Bram Hartwell, a pastry chef whose café is three missed payments from gone, believes second chances are for people with better timing. But when a snowstorm strands two rivals with the best mistake of their twenties, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must say the sentence that has been rehearsed for a decade, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
